verdict.rationale: Baseten builds TensorRT-optimized containers via Truss, markets Model APIs as high-performance LLM endpoints, streams tokens over SSE, and routes sessions to replicas so shared prefixes stay in the KV cache. A Performance Client handles concurrent high-throughput requests, and a community developer reports the server was fast enough that the Python client became the bottleneck. Missing for 10: no documented time-to-first-token or tokens/sec figures or benchmarks, and no independent latency measurements beyond one anecdotal throughput report.
